title: Two acute angles
body: A student working on compound angles takes two acute angles A and B with sin A = 3/5 and cos B = 12/13. She plans to find cos A and sin B first, from sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, choosing positive values because both angles are acute. She will then use cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B and sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B to find the trigonometric values of A + B and A - B.
